notes: PatchWAM is a unified world-action model that represents a 16-step action chunk as patch tokens and jointly denoises them with future-frame latent tokens. This checkpoint was trained from scratch using RoboCasa365 Human300 only, with no Target50 data: 5 epochs, 16 H800 GPUs, per-GPU batch 16, global batch 256, gradient accumulation 1, learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-2, cosine scheduling, and bf16. Evaluation used RoboCasa 1.0.1, split=pretrain, replan=16, 10 denoise steps, seed 7, and 50 trials per task. Results contain 1,189 successes over 2,500 episodes with zero aborted episodes: Atomic-Seen 708/900, Composite-Seen 371/800, and Composite-Unseen 110/800. W&B ran offline. The PatchWAM paper is currently under double-blind review; a public paper URL will be added upon release.
